claims.statement: Project lifecycle guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES; it does not specify an exhaustive permission matrix. Procedural access to settings is not native authority to close/delete projects.

Deletion permanently removes project according to source; danger-zone flow requires warnings, exact project-name confirmation and consequence acknowledgement. Confirmation UI is not a backup, recoverability receipt or deletion approval.
Closing removes project from active project list while retaining contents and ability to reopen. Closed project is not deleted, content disposed, issues closed or acceptance work completed.

Source does not specify closed-project automation execution, access changes, data retention duration or restoration after deletion. Do not infer disabled workflows, revoked visibility or recoverable permanent deletion.

Organization and user reopening navigate appropriate account/project list, show closed projects, select exact project and choose Re-open in Settings. Matching display name alone should not substitute for stable owner/project identity.

Reopen instructions indicate possible recovery from closure, not tested preservation of fields, access, automation or item state. No project closed, reopened or deleted; claims remain reference-only pending native behavior and approval evidence.
